data: Apple reported diluted earnings per share of $7.46 in fiscal 2025 (year ended September 27, 2025), compared with $6.08 in fiscal 2024 (year ended September 28, 2024). That is an increase of $1.38, or about 22.7%. Net income for fiscal 2025 was $112,010 million (about $112.0 billion), up from $93,736 million in fiscal 2024, a gain of roughly 19.5%. EPS grew faster than net income because the diluted share count fell from about 15.41 billion to about 15.00 billion shares, reflecting buybacks. Fiscal 2024 net income was also held down by a higher tax provision of $29,749 million versus $20,719 million in fiscal 2025.
